parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, project_type, location_province, location_city, property_type, property_area_m2, budget_target, urgency, current_phase, metadata
FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT id, summary, constraints, client_needs FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, version, total_estimated, budget_target, deviation_status FROM cost_estimates WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT directiva, contexto, prioridad, categoria FROM architect_directives WHERE activa = true ORDER BY prioridad DESC LIMIT 15

INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_decision_engine', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ project_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.project_id, decision_context: $('Build Prompt').first().json.decision_context, options_count: $('Build Prompt').first().json.options_input.length, decision_origen: $('Build Prompt').first().json.decision_origen }), JSON.stringify({ request_id: $('Build Prompt').first().json.request_id, source: 'api_decision_engine_evaluate' })] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO decision_log (project_id, tenant_id, decision_origen, agente_recomendador, opciones_evaluadas, opcion_elegida, criterios_decision, justificacion, impacto_economico, impacto_normativo, impacto_energetico, decided_by)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, 'agent_decision_engine', $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, $7::text, $8::numeric, $9::text, $10::text, $11::uuid)
RETURNING id, decided_at

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $json.project_id,
  $json.tenant_id,
  $json.decision_origen,
  JSON.stringify($json.output.options_evaluation),
  JSON.stringify($json.output.recomendacion),
  JSON.stringify($json.output.criterios_aplicados),
  $json.output.recomendacion.justificacion || null,
  (function(){ const r = ($json.output.options_evaluation || []).find(function(o){return o.id === $json.output.recomendacion.opcion_id;}); return r && r.impacto_economico_eur ? r.impacto_economico_eur : null; })(),
  (function(){ const r = ($json.output.options_evaluation || []).find(function(o){return o.id === $json.output.recomendacion.opcion_id;}); return r && r.impacto_normativo ? r.impacto_normativo : null; })(),
  (function(){ const r = ($json.output.options_evaluation || []).find(function(o){return o.id === $json.output.recomendacion.opcion_id;}); return r && r.impacto_energetico ? r.impacto_energetico : null; })(),
  $json.user_id
] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), output = $2::jsonb, metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ data: { project_id: $('Format Response').first().json.project_id, decision_log_id: $('Insert Decision Log').first().json.id, decided_at: $('Insert Decision Log').first().json.decided_at, decision_origen: $('Format Response').first().json.decision_origen, decision_context: $('Format Response').first().json.decision_context, output: $('Format Response').first().json.output, summary: $('Format Response').first().json.summary }, meta: { request_id: $('Format Response').first().json.request_id, model: $('Format Response').first().json.model, tokens_in: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_in, tokens_out: $('Format Response').first().json.tokens_out, eu_ai_act: 'recomendacion no vinculante, decision final humana' } }) }}
